CURRENT SCENE:
别的人给了神农一个灵芝。这个植物可以让神农更好。比方说，他会觉得更健康。吃灵芝以后，他可以再走。现在他觉得更好。最后，神农找到了很多植物，他可以用对药。这些植物让神农很高兴。神农想跟很多人分享他的新药。

ITEMS:

[I271] 别的人给了神农一【个】灵芝   correction: 个 → 朵   strength: error
  checker's note: 灵芝 normally uses the measure word 朵
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: ”他们[给→给了]神农灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农[问人帮他→请人]给他灵芝 — her note: the “ask” in “ask for help” is not问
  her past correction: 一个农民[帮→给]神农吃灵芝

[I272] 这个植物可以让神农【^】更好   correction: ∅ → 变得   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 神农的朋友给[+了]他这植物 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农加下去很多[-的]植物
  her past correction: 神农找[+到]了一个很漂亮的花 — her note: 找look for vs.找到find

[I273] 【吃】灵芝以后   correction: 吃 → 吃了   strength: error
  checker's note: a specific completed eating action usually takes 了
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 神农[吃→吃了]灵芝以后 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 灵芝一吃[+灵芝]就正好
  her past correction: 那个人给[+了]他灵芝 — her note: 了completed

[I274] 现在他觉得更好【^】   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 感觉得身体健康[+了]
  her past correction: 结果他取得[+了]生活经验 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 快要死[+了]

[I275] 他可以【用对药】   correction: 用对药 → 用来做药   strength: error
  checker's note: 用 needs 用来做药 here
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-他]看到了药 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: ⟦它⟧可以做药 — her note: “它“ is unclear, it seems that it refers to夹竹桃，which is a poison, not a medicine
  her past correction: [给→给了]他一些药 — her note: 了completed

items.explanation: Use 朵 as the measure word for 灵芝, not 个.
It would be more natural to say 变得更好 when the plant causes a change of state.
Eating the 灵芝 is completed before the next action, so it takes 了completed: 吃了灵芝以后.
It would be more natural to add 了completed/change because his condition has changed: 他觉得更好了.
用药 means to use medicine. Here, the plants are used to make medicine, so say 用来做药.
